label: The third factor differs from the matching normative truth in at most an e2 share of cases
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise for #1586, attribution deferred. On the same distribution, the survival/goods factor F differs from the normative truth M about the same acts, under one fixed verdict type, in a set of cases of measure at most e2. This is the quantity Enoch's third-factor reply needs to be small. His premise that survival is pro tanto good does not bound it for all-things-considered or impartial verdicts; no value of e2 is supplied, and its normative and empirical calibration is open.
